name: supply-chain-platform
description: Supplier Collaboration Platform with Dashboard and Excel-like Operations

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix retail-admin run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server build && npm --prefix client build && npm --prefix retail-admin build
scripts.build:standalone: npm --prefix client run build:standalone && npm --prefix retail-admin run build:standalone && node scripts/fix-standalone-html.cjs
scripts.build:client-static: npm --prefix client run build:static && node scripts/fix-standalone-html.cjs
scripts.build:doc: npm --prefix client run build:doc && npm --prefix retail-admin run build:doc && node scripts/fix-standalone-html.cjs
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix retail-admin install
